entries.description: How many monthly-table rates it is the average of; 1 otherwise. An average never sets a GST amount (ENG-42).

of.description: The date the rate is of: the day, the feed's earlier date, or the month's first day.

rate.description: Base currency per one unit of currency: the rate a posting on the date takes when its document has no rate of its own.

source.description: Where the rate comes from, as a converted amount records it.

step.description: The cascade's step: the organisation's rate for the day, the daily feed (on the date or up to 7 days before), or the monthly table.
